title: I'm a solo student dev working on a text-based Narrative AI game. Looking for a partner to help it grow.
author: CantThinkOfAName1147
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm a university student and for the past months, I’ve been pouring my spare time into a passion project: **AI Kingdom**. It's a strategy game with a core idea I was really excited about: what if you could rule a kingdom by talking to your AI council?

I finally launched it about a month ago, mostly by sharing it on a few Reddit communities, and got some responses.

Here's where the project is at right now:

* 500+ sign-ups and $231 in revenue in the first month, all completely organic.
* A small but awesome core community of about \~10 daily active players has formed.
* The game is fully playable in-browser, with a unique Narrative AI that generates and evaluates story events based on the player's written solutions.

But here’s the reality: I’ve hit my personal limits. I only know how to code and turn my idea into a reality.

* The art and graphics are very basic, as you'll see. I'm no artist.
* I have zero experience in marketing. All the growth so far has come from pure luck and passionate communities.
* As a university student, my time is very limited.

I truly believe the core concept of the game has a lot of potential, but these limitations are holding it back.

I'd be incredibly grateful if you could take a moment to play the game and share your thoughts.

Play the game here: [https://www.playaikingdom.com/](https://www.playaikingdom.com/)

My main questions for you all are: What do you think? Do you see the potential here?

And more importantly, is there anyone out there who finds this project as exciting as I do? I'm looking for a partner, a true collaborator who believes in the vision and can complement my skills, whether that's in art, marketing, community management, or all of the above.

This is a passion side-project for now, with any revenue being shared. The main goal isn't to get rich quick, but to build something unique and cool together.

replies.author: Appropriate-Ask6418
replies.body: AI Kingdom sounds fantastic! The idea of ruling through conversation is genius - it's like being a monarch in a world where your advisors actually have infinite patience for your terrible decisions. 😄 The concept of narrative AI generating and evaluating story events based on written solutions is incredibly cool. Best of luck finding the right collaborator - sounds like you've built something genuinely unique!

comments.author: MrEktidd
comments.body: This is actually pretty cool. What program are you building this in? Ive always been a fan of anything kingdom builder. Would definitely be up to have a discussion!

comments.author: PikachuDash
comments.body:
I'm working on an AI game also, so I'm unfortunately not able to come onboard. But I would like to congratulate you so far.


If I may offer some feedback:


- I'm on mobile, and the website is difficult to use there because it all looks zoomed out. Maybe you can optimise that.
- The onboarding could be better, I didn't really understand what my objective was, what problems to solve in my kingdom and so on. But I see that the "Guide" tab tells me exactly what I need to know, so maybe you can guide new players there automatically.
- I like the concept of talking to different council members, it's quite clear whom to talk about what and it gives me an immediate idea of what managing the kingdom entails. Nice idea!


May I ask, what Reddit communities were you successful with in regards to marketing?


Good luck :)

comments.author: JustSayGames
comments.body: Hello there! I'm very interested in your project and perhaps helping you make it into something big! Right now I'm trying to gain some experience with marketing and production and would love to learn along side you! Check DMs

comments.author: IndianaNetworkAdmin
comments.body:
Some of my favorite long running games have been purely text-based things I did through ChatGPT. Back when I paid for it I made an 'Isekai Villain' custom and it was great. It created a council for me with fun people like Minister Tharn, Master of Coin and Decay.

I'm trying yours now.
